one_improvement.candidate: Use a receipt-joined dependency-cut worksheet before assigning a marginal agent: compare exact cohort intake delta with the earliest shared missing gate, then trial one agent on the next independently reviewable gate receipt while retaining intake work in another lane.
one_improvement.failure_behavior: If no independently reviewable next gate packet exists, do not release; keep agent on bounded offline preparation or intake and record no trial.
one_improvement.falsifier: A newer accepted independent route/graph already bypasses v2b, or v2b cannot pass offline gates; recompute dependency cut before spending another live cycle.
one_improvement.invalidation: Recompute when a newer graph/route or startup receipt appears; reject stale summary or unrooted candidate as gate progress.
one_improvement.key: TASK-SUMMARY SHA + exact root intake/static/qualification receipts + last accepted host gate and next absent gate
one_improvement.mechanism: Moves effort to the dependency cut that prevents using already-ready inputs, instead of increasing a queue that cannot yet launch; makes the cut and its evidence explicit.
one_improvement.pilot_result: Offline join verified this cohort +1 raw/+2 static/+1 qualified/0 starts, with v2a syntax rc0 but listener/remote graph absent; no dispatch.
one_improvement.promotion_gate: After one cycle compare verified gate transition and intake throughput, then independently decide whether to reuse method. Do not infer 200 APK unlock from a local listener PASS.
one_improvement.risk: The identified route may fail and other paths may be cheaper; refresh route evidence and compare alternatives before release.
one_improvement.scope: One dispatch-cycle pilot only; no global scheduling change, no claim of expected startup count or guaranteed unlock.
one_improvement.success_receipt: Root-accepted exact local listener identity and route behavior without global proxy mutation; still no startup claim.
one_improvement.trial: For one cycle, move one otherwise incremental-intake agent to an independently reviewed v2b local listener/route readback packet; preserve another intake lane.

problem: Portfolio has 102 accepted raw identities, 100 four-phase static inventories and 17 qualified blackbox test inputs, but zero verified cold starts. Marginal intake keeps growing while common HelloWorld host path has not reached remote graph or launch.
unknowns: Whether v2b will pass, whether gz02 route will authenticate, and what first HelloWorld runtime wall appears.
How many static APKs will eventually share the same post-build startup wall.
